dialogues.jp: ズズズ……。
dialogues.en: Sip, sip......
dialogues.text: Sip, sip......

dialogues.jp: 紅茶を一口飲み、ひと息つく。
dialogues.en: I sipped on the tea and sighed.
dialogues.text: I sipped on the tea and sighed.

dialogues.jp:
待ち合わせの５分前。萌先輩はまだ来ていない。
窓際の席に腰かけ、恋人を待つ。
dialogues.en:
It's 5 minutes before the time we're suppose to meet, and
Moe-sempai isn't here yet. I sat on the seat by the window
and waited for her.
dialogues.text:
It's 5 minutes before the time we're suppose to meet, and
Moe-sempai isn't here yet. I sat on the seat by the window
and waited for her.

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、萌先輩なら十中八九、遅刻だろうな
　……）
dialogues.en: (I'm pretty sure she'll be late......)
dialogues.text: (I'm pretty sure she'll be late......)

dialogues.jp:
普通は『待った？』と言う男に『ううん、私も
今来たところだから』と女の子が言うのが定番
なんだが……。
dialogues.en:
Typically, a boyfriend's supposed to be a little late and
apologize to his girlfriend......
dialogues.text:
Typically, a boyfriend's supposed to be a little late and
apologize to his girlfriend......

dialogues.jp: 俺たちだと逆になりそうだ。
dialogues.en: In our case, it's the opposite.
dialogues.text: In our case, it's the opposite.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、気長に待ちますか」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, I'll just wait for her."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, I'll just wait for her."

dialogues.jp: ズズズ……。
dialogues.en: Sip, sip......
dialogues.text: Sip, sip......

dialogues.jp: 俺は再びカップに口をつけ、紅茶を飲む。
dialogues.en: I sipped on my tea again.
dialogues.text: I sipped on my tea again.

dialogues.jp: やっぱ紅茶はホットだな。
dialogues.en: This tea's very hot.
dialogues.text: This tea's very hot.

dialogues.jp: ズズズ……。
dialogues.en: Sip, sip......
dialogues.text: Sip, sip......

dialogues.jp:
カップを受け皿にもどし、ひと息つく。甘いコ
コアの香りが、俺を落ち着かせてくれる。
dialogues.en:
I sighed while putting the cup on the saucer. The sweet
flavor of cocoa was calming me down.
dialogues.text:
I sighed while putting the cup on the saucer. The sweet
flavor of cocoa was calming me down.

dialogues.jp: 紅茶に｛・・・／飽きた｝ので、今はココアだ。
dialogues.en: I had enough of the tea, so I'm drinking cocoa now.
dialogues.text: I had enough of the tea, so I'm drinking cocoa now.

dialogues.jp:
俺がここに来てから、すでに２時間と５分が経
過している。
dialogues.en: It's been 2 hours and 5 minutes since I got here.
dialogues.text: It's been 2 hours and 5 minutes since I got here.

dialogues.jp:
（まあこのぐらいなら、予想ギリギリ｛はんちゅう／範疇｝内っ
　てところか）
dialogues.en: (This is still about what I expected.)
dialogues.text: (This is still about what I expected.)

dialogues.jp:
雪の中、ベンチで待っているのに比べれば、全
然、楽ってもんだ。
dialogues.en:
It's not like I'm waiting for her in the snow outside. It's
not too bad.
dialogues.text:
It's not like I'm waiting for her in the snow outside. It's
not too bad.

dialogues.jp: ズズズ……。
dialogues.en: Sip, sip......
dialogues.text: Sip, sip......

dialogues.jp: 口の中に、甘い味が広がる。
dialogues.en: My mouth was full of sweet flavor.
dialogues.text: My mouth was full of sweet flavor.

dialogues.jp: カチャカチャカチャ……。
dialogues.en: Clatter, clatter......
dialogues.text: Clatter, clatter......

dialogues.jp: 「はぐはぐはぐ……」
dialogues.en: "Yum, yum......"
dialogues.text: "Yum, yum......"

dialogues.jp:
食器を鳴らして、食事をとる。さすがに液体ば
かりじゃ、胃がつらい。
dialogues.en:
I tapped the plate while eating my meal. My stomach was
getting tired of liquids.
dialogues.text:
I tapped the plate while eating my meal. My stomach was
getting tired of liquids.

dialogues.jp: すでに短針が約束の時間の反対側を指している。
dialogues.en:
The short hand on the clock was already pointing in the
opposite direction of our scheduled time.
dialogues.text:
The short hand on the clock was already pointing in the
opposite direction of our scheduled time.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の家に電話したら、１１時ぐらいには出
たらしいし。
dialogues.en:
I called her home and found out that she had left home
around 11am.
dialogues.text:
I called her home and found out that she had left home
around 11am.

dialogues.jp:
途中で寝てる可能性もあるけど、やはり、すれ
違いが怖い。
dialogues.en:
She might have fallen asleep on her way here, but I hope we
didn't miss each other.
dialogues.text:
She might have fallen asleep on her way here, but I hope we
didn't miss each other.

dialogues.jp:
（夜の公園で、何時間でも待っちゃうようなヒ
　ロインみたくなれってか）
dialogues.en:
(I should just stay here and wait for her forever like a
character from a romance movie.)
dialogues.text:
(I should just stay here and wait for her forever like a
character from a romance movie.)

dialogues.jp:
いつ来てもおかしくないし、来なくてもおかし
くない。そんな｛あいまい／曖昧｝な状態に縛られ、動くこと
が出来なかった。
dialogues.en:
She could be here any minute now, or she may never show up.
I was caught up in this situation and unable to move.
dialogues.text:
She could be here any minute now, or she may never show up.
I was caught up in this situation and unable to move.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか……つかれたな……」
dialogues.en: "I'm tired......"
dialogues.text: "I'm tired......"

dialogues.jp:
閉店時間になり、店を追い出されてから、そろ
そろ２時間になる。もうじき短針が一周する。
dialogues.en:
It's been almost 2 hours since I was kicked out of the cafe
after closing. The short hand on the clock has almost made a
full round trip.
dialogues.text:
It's been almost 2 hours since I was kicked out of the cafe
after closing. The short hand on the clock has almost made a
full round trip.

dialogues.jp:
シャッターの下りた店の前にしゃがみ込み、身
体を丸める。はたから見たら、かなり奇怪な存
在に見えるだろう。
dialogues.en:
I squatted in front of the closed cafe, and balled up my
body. I probably look strange to other people.
dialogues.text:
I squatted in front of the closed cafe, and balled up my
body. I probably look strange to other people.

dialogues.jp: ふと、街灯の光が｛さえぎ／遮｝られた。
dialogues.en:
Then moment, something blocked out the street light in front
of me.
dialogues.text:
Then moment, something blocked out the street light in front
of me.

dialogues.jp: 顔を上げると、そこに萌先輩が立っていた。
dialogues.en: When I looked up, Moe-sempai was standing there.
dialogues.text: When I looked up, Moe-sempai was standing there.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「すみません、遅れました……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry, I'm late......"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, I'm late......"

dialogues.jp: ペコリと頭を下げる萌先輩。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai bowed at me.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai bowed at me.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず怒るとかそんなことよりも、無事な
姿に安心のため息が漏れてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Before I got angry, I was relieved to know that she was
safe.
dialogues.text:
Before I got angry, I was relieved to know that she was
safe.

dialogues.jp: 「ぅぅぅ……遅いです萌先輩……」
dialogues.en: "Uhhh...... you're late, Moe-sempai......"
dialogues.text: "Uhhh...... you're late, Moe-sempai......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「本当にすみませんでした」
dialogues.en: "I'm very sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm very sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、ちゃんと来てくれましたから、いいで
　すよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, you're here now, so it's all good."
dialogues.text: "Well, you're here now, so it's all good."

dialogues.jp: ホント、来ないよりは全然いい――。
dialogues.en: It's better than not showing up......
dialogues.text: It's better than not showing up......

dialogues.jp: かもしれない。
dialogues.en: I think......
dialogues.text: I think......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「本当にごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "I'm so sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm so sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go now?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go now?"

dialogues.jp: 話を打ち切るように、歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I started walking as I spoke.
dialogues.text: I started walking as I spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どこに行くんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Where are we going?"
dialogues.text: "Where are we going?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな……」
dialogues.en: "Let's see......"
dialogues.text: "Let's see......"

dialogues.jp:
もう夜遅い時間だしな。開いている店で萌先輩
とデートできるようなところはないように思わ
れる。
dialogues.en: It's too late to find a nice spot to have a date with her.
dialogues.text: It's too late to find a nice spot to have a date with her.

dialogues.jp: 「……桜公園にしましょう」
dialogues.en: "......Let's go to Sakura Park."
dialogues.text: "......Let's go to Sakura Park."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「え？　でもそこは昨日だめって言ってません
　でした？」
dialogues.en:
"What? But I thought you said you didn't want to go there
yesterday."
dialogues.text:
"What? But I thought you said you didn't want to go there
yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今回は特別です。いやですか？」
dialogues.en: "This time's special. You don't want to go?"
dialogues.text: "This time's special. You don't want to go?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ」
dialogues.en: "No, I want to go."
dialogues.text: "No, I want to go."

dialogues.jp:
フルフルと首を横に振る萌先輩。ポニーテール
の髪が左右に踊る。
dialogues.en:
She shook her head side to side. Her ponytail was dancing
from right to left.
dialogues.text:
She shook her head side to side. Her ponytail was dancing
from right to left.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、でも“お昼寝”はダメですからね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, but we aren't going to take a nap."
dialogues.text: "Oh, but we aren't going to take a nap."

dialogues.jp:
“昼寝”という表現が適切かどうかは、この際
おいておく。
dialogues.en:
I don't know if the term 'nap' is still correct to use at
this time.
dialogues.text:
I don't know if the term 'nap' is still correct to use at
this time.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「残念です……」
dialogues.en: "Bummer......"
dialogues.text: "Bummer......"

dialogues.jp:
夜、外で眠ったりしたら、それこそマジで洒落
にならない。
dialogues.en:
It wouldn't be very funny if she took a nap at night in the
park.
dialogues.text:
It wouldn't be very funny if she took a nap at night in the
park.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩に釘をさし、桜公園へと向かう。
dialogues.en: I warned Moe-sempai and headed toward Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: I warned Moe-sempai and headed toward Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
桜の花びらが街灯の光に照らされ、キラキラと
舞っていた。
dialogues.en:
The cherry blossom petals were shining in the street lights
as they fell from the trees.
dialogues.text:
The cherry blossom petals were shining in the street lights
as they fell from the trees.

dialogues.jp: ◆長々と待つ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Waited for a long time◆
dialogues.text: ◆Waited for a long time◆

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩と外で待ち合わせてデートしたのだが、
長々と遅刻されてしまったのだった。
dialogues.en:
I was going to have a date with Moe-sempai, but she left me
waiting for a long time.
dialogues.text:
I was going to have a date with Moe-sempai, but she left me
waiting for a long time.
